messages:
Jonathan_Cust: Hey team — after yesterday's RBAC role-remap my org (org: heliodyn-creative) can no longer access models or billing in the console. 'You do not have access' on models page and billing throws a 403. Can you help?
Ashley_Support: Sorry you're seeing this — we're looking. quick Q: are you an org-admin previously or a billing-owner? also can you paste the console error or screenshot? :eyes:
Jonathan_Cust: I was org-admin before. Screenshot attached (not in thread). Console shows: `403: PermissionDenied: resource.projects.models.get` and billing UI shows `403 - access denied`.
Ashley_Support: thanks. @Vince_SecEng ping — sounds like role attribute mapping may have dropped org-admin binding during the refactor last night. Can you check the role-sync job and any attribute squashing for heliodyn-creative?
Vince_SecEng: looking. I see a partial rolesync at 02:14 UTC yesterday with a 'squashLegacyAdmins=true' flag. The audit log shows this entry: ```
{"ts":"2025-06-17T02:14:23Z","actor":"rolesync-service","action":"apply","org":"heliodyn-creative","changes":[{"id":"role-admin","op":"replace","attrs":{"scope":"project"}}]}
```
Vince_SecEng: That replace removed the org-level admin binding and turned it into project-scoped admin for some users. Not ideal. Probably the attribute filter pattern didn't match org-level identity for a few accounts (including Jonathan).
Ashley_Support: Carla, any chance the KMS-backed service token used for rolesync re-encryption failed? I vaguely remember a KMS rotation warning yesterday.
Carla_SRE: there was a KMS warning at 02:05 UTC: `kms:Decryption failed for key rk-sync-01 - permission denied for serviceacct:rolesync-svc`. I rotated the key last week; it looks like rolesync didn't pick up the new grant. rolesync retried but with limited permissions, so the partial apply at 02:14 makes sense.
Vince_SecEng: plan: 1) revert the rolesync apply for heliodyn-creative to the pre-02:14 state, 2) re-run rolesync after granting the service account Decrypt on rk-sync-01, 3) verify Jonathan has org-admin binding. I can run revert now if Ashley authorizes.
Ashley_Support: please go ahead. Jonathan, I'll keep you posted.
Vince_SecEng: rolled back the rolesync for heliodyn-creative at 02:56 UTC. Audit entry: ```
{"ts":"2025-06-17T02:56:12Z","actor":"rolesync-service","action":"revert","org":"heliodyn-creative","status":"success","notes":"reapplied pre-change bindings"}
```
Vince_SecEng: also granted rolesync-svc the Decrypt role on rk-sync-01 and re-ran a dry-run then apply. New audit: ```
{"ts":"2025-06-17T03:05:03Z","actor":"rolesync-service","action":"apply","org":"heliodyn-creative","status":"success"}
```
Ashley_Support: Jonathan — can you check console now? You may need to log out/in or clear SSO session.
Jonathan_Cust: I signed out and back in. Models page loads, billing loads, and I can see org-settings again. Thank you! :raised_hands:
Ashley_Support: great, closing the loop. We'll open a follow-up with infra to add an alert if rolesync encounters KMS decrypt failures during apply. @Vince_SecEng can you create a short postmortem and mitigation tracking?
Vince_SecEng: will do. Drafting now and will link the playbook entry to avoid future partial-applies.
rbac-bot: Incident created #INC-2025-4827 for 'rolesync partial apply due to KMS permission' assigned to Eng-Security, SRE.
Ashley_Support: tagging this resolved for the customer; follow-up tasks in INC-2025-4827. Thanks everyone!
